What services does BiltRx offer?

BiltRx specializes in telemedicine services focusing on:

- Men’s Health: Addressing issues such as low testosterone, erectile dysfunction, and prostate health.
- Women’s Health: Providing care for hormonal imbalances, menopause management, and reproductive health.
- Weight Loss & Metabolic Health: Offering personalized programs to help you achieve and maintain a healthy weight.
- Aesthetic & Wellness Therapies: Enhancing your well-being with treatments like skin rejuvenation and IV hydration therapy.
- Specialized & Alternative Therapies: Including services such as acupuncture, massage therapy, and more.

How do I get started with BiltRx?

Embarking on your health journey with BiltRx is straightforward:

- Step 1: Create Your Account

Visit our website and set up your secure profile. This grants you access to our network of healthcare professionals.
- Step 2: Consult with a Specialist

Schedule a virtual consultation at your convenience. Our licensed experts will provide personalized care tailored to your needs.
- Step 3: Receive Your Treatment Plan

Based on your consultation, you’ll receive a customized treatment plan. If medications are prescribed, they will be delivered directly to your doorstep.

Are BiltRx's services available in my area?

BiltRx offers telemedicine services that can be accessed from various locations. Please check our website or contact our support team to confirm availability in your area.

Where will my prescriptions be filled?

Your prescription will be filled by one of our third-party compounding pharmacies **_(i.e. Southend Pharmacy_****_[(855) 414-5356](tel:8554145356)_** **_and Boothwyn pharmacy_****_[(800) 476-7496](tel:8004767496)_** **_)_** and mailed directly to your shipping address on file.

Some patients may be eligible to request that their prescription be sent to a local pharmacy of this choice. This option is most commonly offered for commercially available medications. Please note that local pharmacy prescription costs are not included in our fees and any charges will be the patient’s responsibility. BiltRx cannot guarantee the quality or availability of medications provided by local pharmacies. If you are interested in having your prescription sent to a local pharmacy, please reach out to [care@biltrx.com](mailto:care@biltrx.com) for further assistance.

Does BiltRx offer subscription-based products?

Yes. Some BiltRx products are available with a subscription option. Subscriptions allow for automatic recurring delivery, helping ensure you don’t run out of product while also offering better value compared to one-time purchases.
